author: template-projects
name: Aspire starter add-on: Blazor front end
description: Adds a Blazor UI written once in a Razor Class Library and rendered by the hosts you ask for: a WebAssembly web host, a MAUI Blazor Hybrid mobile/desktop host, or both. Emits .scaffold/aspire-ui-blazor.wiring.md, which lists the solution and AppHost edits the scaffolding skill applies.

web.description: Include the Blazor WebAssembly host. This is the only client that genuinely needs CORS on the API.

maui.description: Include the MAUI Blazor Hybrid host for mobile and desktop. Requires the MAUI workload to build; the AppHost holds it back with WithExplicitStart so `aspire run` still works without it.

modifiers.comment: The Pages RCL and its bUnit suite carry the whole UI; without a host to render them there is nothing to add.
